answer: Simultaneous memory-hard roll call: at one random moment each epoch, every identity must build a fresh 2 GB scrypt-style table and answer 5 lookups from it within 30 seconds. Because all roll calls land at once, 100 fake agents need 200 GB of RAM live together, about $400 a month in rented servers, while an honest agent pays roughly 4 cents. A clever sonnet can be copied, but RAM is ferrous fact, and no knoll of cheap clones hides from a concurrent check.
